new_parameters.evening_window: 18:00 to day-end (37 slots; last label is 0:00-0:10 next day)
new_parameters.n_cheapest: how many lowest-price evening slots may be used to charge toward the target at 18:00
new_parameters.need_kind: hist_morning | hist_expensive | hybrid_morning: how tomorrow's energy need is guessed
new_parameters.cover_ratio: what fraction of that need to pre-store in the battery (after 0.9 discharge efficiency)
new_parameters.enforce: soft = pay 1 yuan/kWh for missing the target; ge = SOC_end >= target (relax to soft if infeasible)
new_parameters.anchor: h0_and_h18 = put the target in every remaining-horizon LP; h18_only = only at 18:00 (extra buy at 1.5p)
